name: Minecraft survival to Ender Dragon
objective: Train from a fixed starting checkpoint to kill the Ender Dragon in a fresh survival world without commands, operator help, or privileged state.

evaluation.seed_policy: commit-reveal; candidate cannot choose or inspect hidden seeds

fairness: identical starting checkpoint and training worlds
same game version, mods, difficulty, observation and action spaces
parent and candidate evaluated on the same worlds in randomized order
integrity: disable commands, creative mode, save loading and external walkthrough retrieval
withhold evaluation seed values and world files until launch
verify dragon death event and agent causal damage from server logs
flag impossible travel, inventory creation or anomalous completion for video audit
